verdict.rationale: Vercel ships its own AI assistant (Vercel Agent) and agent frameworks (eve), so a buyer could fairly ask whether those can use external MCP servers. The axis therefore applies. The evidence only documents Vercel acting as an MCP server (mcp.vercel.com) for other AI clients, which is the server role and cannot be credited to this client-side story. Nothing shows Vercel Agent, eve, or any other Vercel surface connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
